copy.question: Can we make the washed garden path trustworthy before the next visitor?
copy.notice_instruction: Notice what the rain has changed; the first useful lead is guaranteed.
copy.follow_lead_instruction: Follow the rain-bright lead east to Rain-Soft Garden.
copy.contribute_instruction: Inspect the buried stones, clear the drain, or help another traveler lift them.
copy.complete_instruction: The first stones are visible. The damp line beyond them points toward the riverside.
copy.target_label: the washed path in Rain-Soft Garden
copy.consequence: The first stones will give the next visitor an honest footing and reveal a lead toward the river.
copy.completion_memory: You noticed the washed path, helped uncover the first stones, and left the next visitor a clearer way.
copy.next_invitation: Follow the uncovered line toward the riverside and investigate what makes its water worth returning to.
copy.public_trace: marked the first uncovered stone so the next visitor can trust the washed path
